title: Camera-Based 3D Scanner
summary: Reworking a FlashForge Creator Pro for focus-variation scanning, with evolving camera-mount CAD, OpenCV and guarded motion control.
cover_alt: Current camera mounting design for the 3D scanner, shown in perspective CAD.

title: Portable Cyberdeck PC
summary: A desktop PC with an Intel Core i5-12400F, Radeon RX 5600 XT, 500 W power supply and integrated 24-inch monitor, built into a rugged case so it can be moved between locations.
cover_alt: Presentation-enhanced photograph of the portable cyberdeck computer and desk setup.

title: Custom Two-Speed RC Car
summary: A 1:20 mining-haul RC vehicle with two-speed dog clutch, four-wheel drive and servo dumping, tested with payloads up to 1.55 kg.
cover_alt: Side view of the custom RC car with blue wheels, white printed suspension arms, exposed gears and electronics.

title: Custom Tracked RC Tank
summary: A 620 g tracked rover with 3D-printed links, suspended rollers, ESP32 control and a measured average course time of 11.30 s.
cover_alt: Angled view of the custom tracked RC tank chassis, showing red printed treads, drive units and exposed electronics.
